fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Battle, map and menu scratch: mech work table, name buffer, inventory counts, map buffers. Not save data: wiped when play returns to the title, and the save routines copy out only the parts they keep
fields.evidence: cleared on return to title after suspending (all 0x4122 bytes zero); rewritten constantly during play

fields.name: occupancy scratch
fields.meaning: Tile occupancy map used only during battle: tile row*width+col holds unit index|0x80. Zero at the title; never saved
fields.evidence: code f000:4bfd writes it; pre-save battle memory matches all 8 active units at tile=y*30+x

fields.name: suspend: battle units
fields.meaning: 32 battle units of 94 bytes (player + enemy mechs on the map), copied whole and restored on CONTINUE. Not checksummed
fields.evidence: save code f000:b2f5 / restore f000:b37e; empty slots are 0xff-filled

fields.name: suspend: turn number
fields.evidence: save/restore code f000:b2f5/f000:b37e; turn 4->5 across one more player+enemy phase; stored per mission at mission end

fields.name: suspend: battle view state
fields.meaning: Four battle state bytes; the last two are set to 5 and 6 at battle start
fields.evidence: save/restore code; battle-init code sets the last two bytes

fields.name: suspend: map dimensions
fields.meaning: Map width and height in tiles (30x24 in the first battle); the resume code also seeds the initial view origin from them (2*W-26, 2*H-17)
fields.evidence: used as stride, area and clamp bound in map code (f000:4bfd/2f04, 8000:52a7); loaded from per-map ROM data at setup; constant across turns and cursor moves

fields.name: suspend: extra table copy
fields.meaning: Copy of the 64-byte block at 7e4e; all zero in every save

fields.name: format signature
fields.meaning: 22 22 55 55 88 88 aa aa. Missing on first save clears 0x58f2-0x7d31 and resets the slot table
fields.evidence: init code f000:ad94; appears exactly when the first suspend is written

fields.name: slot-used words
fields.meaning: One word per record (slots 1-4, then suspend): 0 = empty, else (mission+1)*256 + area. The suspend word clears on resume, so a suspend works once
fields.evidence: writer f000:acfe, boot check f000:ab30, consume-on-resume f000:b415; resume diffs

fields.name: slot level
fields.meaning: Level shown per LOAD GAME slot (copy of 7d48 at save time)

fields.name: last computed level
fields.meaning: Level of the last saved pilot slot (a save-loop quirk: recomputed per pilot, last one wins; 1 with a small party)
fields.evidence: serializer f000:af14 with level routine f000:53b7 over the ROM threshold table

fields.name: title menu mode
fields.meaning: 0 = no save, 1 = slots exist, 2 = suspend exists
fields.evidence: boot check f000:ab30 recomputes it; writers in save paths

fields.name: last slot
fields.meaning: Last used LOAD GAME slot 0-3 (menu cursor)

fields.name: extra table
fields.meaning: Copied into every suspend; no other writer exists in the code; always zero. Effectively unused; purpose unknown
fields.evidence: only references are the suspend copy in/out; zero in every save

fields.name: not used
fields.meaning: The game never touches the console EEPROM
fields.evidence: identical to blank in every save

values.value: game never reads/writes the console EEPROM (diff-proven)
